title: AcceptRejectDecisionEvent
description: One explicit accept/reject at the point of decision (Who Owns the Text, Pattern 5). Process evidence only: hashes and offsets, never corpus text. Not an author verdict, not a 知音 result, and not a close of E05b or E7.

event_id.description: Stable id for this decision point.

ts_iso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the explicit accept, reject, edit-then-accept, or dismiss.

suggestion_id.description: Id of the suggestion being decided. Generation is not commit.

source.description: Model or skill id that produced the suggestion. Not an author identity and not a verdict.

span.description: Optional offsets plus sha256 of the before/after spans, or empty strings. Do not put raw text here. If both start and end are set, end must be >= start.

load_bearing_flag.description: Optional author mark, not a model score. true: this suggestion touches a 承重句, so an accept stays auditable. false: author marked it as not load-bearing, so commodity fluency stays distinguishable at decision time. Omitted: unmarked, not a verdict.

notes.description: Optional short note. Do not paste corpus text. A note is not an author verdict and does not close an arm.
